newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyushu Electric to purchase power from two firms. [CORRECTED 06:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Kyushu Electric to purchase power from two firms. [CORRECTED 06:00 GMT]

text.p: Kyushu Electric Power Co Inc said on Wednesday that it would purchase up to 274,000 kilowatts (kw) of electricity starting in 1999 from two companies.
The electricity utility said in a statement that it has awarded contracts to Nippon Steel Corp and Kyushu Oil Co Ltd (corrects company name) for 137,000 kw, respectively.
Kyushu Electric added that it planned to issue a tender this year to purchase about 200,000 kw for two years starting in fiscal 2001.
